description: VN 'Tôi đồng ý' transfer: learners treat đồng ý (a verb) as an adjective and insert a copula ('I am agree'). Rule en-vietlish-be-agree drops the inserted copula (am/are/'m/'re) for first/second-person + plural subjects (I/you/we/they) directly before bare 'agree', preserving subject casing. He/she/it is OUT of scope (would need 'agrees').
fp_risk_note: Low risk. 'agree' is a verb, not an adjective. V1 only drops am/are/'m/'re after I/you/we/they directly before bare 'agree'. Negatives lock: already-correct 'I agree', the out-of-scope 3rd-singular 'He is agree', the boundary tokens agreed/agreement, and a non-'agree' surface ('a great fan').

positive.notes: Spaced copula 'am' dropped after first-person subject.
Contracted copula 'm attached to subject is dropped -> I agree.

negative.notes: 3rd-singular is OUT of scope (correction would need 'agrees') -> must not fire.

negative.input: I am agreed to the terms
negative.expectedCorrection: I am agreed to the terms.
negative.notes: 'agreed' boundary: (?!d) tail must reject the past-participle surface.
'agreement' boundary: (?!ment) tail must reject the noun.
No 'agree' token at all -> must abstain.
